title: eduLIMS
description: An open-source laboratory information management system (LIMS) for practical laboratory education. Students register samples, upload and check measurements and submit lab reports; teachers grade with a rubric and follow a KPI dashboard. Measurement data is stored as openEHR compositions in FerroEHR.
